name: intent-translation-agent
description: Intent Agent: an agent layer for consumer websites and apps. Platform in platform/, one site pack per site in sites/. Design doc: docs/intent-agent-mini.html

scripts.test: npm run check && node platform/contract/scripts/generate.ts --check && node --test "platform/*/test/*.test.ts" "sites/*/test/*.test.ts"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p platform/contract && tsc -p platform/testkit && tsc -p platform/core && tsc -p platform/core/test && tsc -p platform/brain && tsc -p platform/evals && tsc -p platform/web && tsc -p platform/web/test && tsc -p platform/web/extension && for d in sites/*/; do tsc -p "$d" || exit 1; done
